{{Quote|<nowiki />''Stars'' can ''die''&mdash;?''"<br />"''It is the way of the universe, which is another manner of saying that it is the will of the Force. Everything dies. In time, even stars burn out.|Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="RotS novel" />}}
An ancient '''star system''' centered around a [[Dwarf star/Legends|dwarf star]] that eventually came to die. The [[Black dwarf/Legends|dwarf]], having been hypercompacted into various trace [[Metal/Legends|metals]], hovered in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] at a [[Temperature/Legends|temperature]] only marginally higher than [[absolute zero]]. Early in his [[Time/Legends|time]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] traveled to the system with his [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Master]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. The older [[Gender/Legends|man]] used the frigid sight to impart a lesson on his apprentice: all things pass in time, and it would be a selfish act to hold on to those attachments after their time was up. Skywalker held on to the memory of the system and its frozen [[Star/Legends|star]], haunted by the idea that all things [[Death/Legends|die]].<ref name="RotS novel" />

==Behind the scenes==
The star system was mentioned in [[Matthew Stover]]'s [[2005]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith'']], an adaptation of the [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|film of the same name]].<ref name="RotS novel" /> For his [[2022]] current [[canon]] novel [[Brotherhood (novel)|''Brotherhood'']], author [[Mike Chen (author)|Mike Chen]] included a mention of a [[Unidentified dead star system|dead star system]]<ref name="Brotherhood">[[Brotherhood (novel)|''Brotherhood'']]</ref> with a similar contextual premise, intending the passage to further elaborate on the passage in Stover's ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization.<ref name="Chen Tweet">{{Twitter|mikechenwriter|status/1526649691995111425|[[Mike Chen (author)|Mike Chen]]|date=2022-05-17|quote=#10: 'even stars burned out' -- that whole flashback with Anakin and Obi-Wan fleshes out a moment from Matthew Stover's Revenge of the Sith novelization of a 'minor mission' where Anakin witnessed the death of a star.|archivedate=20220517214211|nolive=1}}</ref>
